sources.citation: Boyd, Virginia Lee. 2015. The phonological systems of the Mbam languages of Cameroon with a focus on vowels and vowel harmony. PhD dissertation, Leiden University (LOT 410). Utrecht: LOT.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing for Tuotomb: Tuotomb is explicitly excluded from the study (Intro p.2-3: 'The four languages not included in this study are Tuɔtɔmb (A46) of the village of Bonek) and Nyokon A45.. It is not included due to a lack of opportunity to collect data for it.'). Only classificatory remarks (closest to Nen lexicostatistically per Phillips 1979 and Mous & Breedveld 1986; has -VC noun-class suffixes).

sources.citation: Lovestrand, Joseph. 2011. Notes on Nyokon phonology (Bantu A.45, Cameroon). Yaoundé: SIL Cameroon.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: Mentions Tuotomb only lexicostatistically (Nyokon 52% resemblance with Tuotomb per Mous & Breedveld 1986); no description of Tuotomb.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en) 'Tuotomb language'; Wikipédia (fr) 'Tuotomb'; Glottolog 5.x languoid page tuot1238; ELAR catalogue search 'Tuotomb'
sources.note: Stubs/catalogue pages; no phonological content. ELAR has only a Tunen (Ndikbiakat) customary-court deposit, nothing on Tuotomb.
